Punjab Bandh Observed Amidst Suspension in Zota Murder Case

The Superintendent of Police (SP) of Gurdaspur has suspended SHO Beant Kaur in connection with the murder case of Parwinder Singh Zota. The suspension marks the first official action in the case. Concurrently, farmer and labor organizations observed a 'Punjab Bandh' (Punjab shutdown), which received significant support in Gurdaspur, leading to closed markets and a general quietude in the district.
